non_blocking_improvements: Before implementing, verify the exact Pi hook for propagating interactive/background invocation metadata into routing.
Benchmark the chosen Ollama model, context size, and concurrency on the 18 GB M3 Pro before turning the local policy into a fixed default.
Add routing observability before broad use: selected tier, concrete model, OpenRouter provider, latency, tokens, cost, fallback/escalation reason.
Decide whether privacy/sensitivity is a hard override axis; sensitive tasks may need local execution even when latency would otherwise favor a hosted model.
uncertainties_to_surface: Capability hints local-ok/economy/premium are conventions introduced by this fork, not documented native Pi tier names.
The fast-hosted mundane path is a proposed pre-routing policy because pi-model-router exposes only low/medium/high.
Concrete Ollama, economy, and premium model aliases remain intentionally unpinned.
qualification: Publish-ready as a design story; not implementation-ready until the urgency metadata hook and local benchmarks are verified.
